info.name: Twilio - Accounts A2p Settings Updates API

params.name: Sim
params.description: Filter the Settings Updates by a Super SIM's SID or UniqueName.

params.name: Status
params.description: Filter the Settings Updates by status. Can be `scheduled`, `in-progress`, `successful`, or `failed`.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of Settings Updates.
